Container.Name: breeze-lora-server-cuda
Container.Overview: OpenAI-compatible HTTP server for Breeze TTS 2 with LoRA adapter hot-swap (CUDA). Mount a models directory that contains server.json (backend: cuda), the Breeze-TTS-2-GGUF package, and any LoRA adapter directories. Relative paths in server.json resolve against that directory. Requires the Unraid Nvidia Driver plugin and an NVIDIA GPU.
Container.Requires: Unraid Nvidia Driver plugin installed and an NVIDIA GPU. Host path must contain server.json with "backend": "cuda", plus Breeze-TTS-2-GGUF and any LoRA adapters referenced by that config.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Read-only host directory containing server.json, Breeze-TTS-2-GGUF/, and loras/. Config is loaded from /models/server.json so relative paths resolve inside this mount.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID from Plugins - Nvidia Driver (recommended), or all.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Required for CUDA containers on Unraid. Use all unless you know you need a narrower set.
